# Veni Grid Benchmark C0 — 1,500 synthetic learner requests (representation baseline)

**Critical status distinction:** C0 tests the demand/section contract and independent witness validator. It does **not** build option blocks automatically, run CP-SAT learner sectioning, allocate teachers/rooms, validate full lesson placements or establish real school search performance. A known solution is **supplied** as a witness, not generated from the demand.

## Synthetic fixture generated by `scripts/build_benchmark_c0.py`

| Dimension | C0 fixture |
| --- | ---: |
| Invented learner identities | 1,500 |
| Requests per learner | 6 |
| Total course-choice requests | 9,000 |
| Subject/section families | 18 |
| Candidate option blocks | 6 |
| Supplied constructed sections | 450 |
| Learners per supplied section | 20 |

All labels are fictitious. Six separate block groups each contain three families; the generator ensures exactly 500 requests per family, then constructs 25 sections of 20. The known witness allocates every request without exceeding section capacity or double-booking a learner's option block. It is deliberately easy by construction and must **not** be marketed as a successful options optimiser.

## C1/C2/C3 progression required for meaningful ACTion and aSc competition

- **C1 choice conflict graph:** synthetic choices intentionally cross candidate block groups; the system must **choose** blocks, section counts and learner assignments. Include incompatible triangles/cycles, scarcity and a known infeasible variant. Track request satisfaction versus proof status. No preassigned answer hidden in the input.
- **C2 combined academic placement:** allocate option sections plus real lesson frequencies, doubles, teachers (including part-time staff), qualifications, rooms, capacities, synchronized lessons, multiple bell regimes and travel constraints.
- **C3 full institution scale:** replicate 1,000–1,500 pupil demand; authentic-shaped 10-day cycle, staffing levels, curriculum hours, parent/learner visibility, real change requests and configured quality weights; record reproducible machine/environment/budget seeds.
- **C4 import parity & UX:** vetted ACTion/aSc/SA-SAMS exports (with valid licenses and de-identification), import mapping, class-balance changes, report generation, rule authoring, conflict diagnosis and single-duty repair. Benchmark experienced school timetablers on representative tasks.

Acceptance requires truthful status semantics. A timeout is UNKNOWN/unfinished, never proven INFEASIBLE. Zero hard-rule violations and separate versioned module publication remain non-negotiable. No real school data in the public repository.
